display_extent_from: all present cumulative-best and population-median summary samples; NOT an all-record plot

positive_point_companion_binding.reason: Exact original parameter serialization is bound before parsing; no approximate numeric comparison or changed coordinate.

progress_events.interpretation: No better stored observation at source serialization precision in the observed contiguous interval; not optimality or physical convergence

source_summary_archive_join.leader_token_authority: bound retained-leaders JSON numeric serialization, not raw CSV spelling
source_summary_archive_join.median: preserved bound full-population source summary; not recomputed by story renderer

target_placement: full text width; final PDF type must be >=8.5pt, target9pt

view_axis.constant_coordinate: epsilon; inverse returns sole original value
view_axis.epsilon_meaning: display floor, not uncertainty or residual
